Name: QingQingCao Cats
Author: StarLight2024
Description:
Two new cats are waiting in Marnie's pet adoption shop. The silver shaded has grey-tipped fur, a cream chest and green eyes; the cow cat is black along the back, white on the chest, with amber eyes. I redrew both by hand on the vanilla cat's frames, so they walk, sit, blink, lick their paws, flop over and leap just like regular cats - they just look different, and Marnie charges a bit more for them.

[/table][b]How to adopt[/b]

They show up in the regular Adopt Pets menu at Marnie's counter, unlocked the same way as vanilla: no pets and Year 2, or after Marnie has offered you a cat through the adoption event. They don't replace the vanilla cats and never appear in the new-game pet picker - the only way to get one is to buy it. Bring an empty pet bowl, pick a cat, name it, done.

[b]Good to know[/b]

[list]
[*]Both behave exactly like the vanilla cat: same gifts, same naps on your bed, same meows (pitched a little differently).[/*]
[*]Names follow your game language, English or Simplified Chinese.[/*]
[*]Prices are one-time, same as vanilla pet adoption.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements and install[/b]

Stardew Valley 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0+, Content Patcher 2.0+. Unzip into
[code]Mods[/code]so the folder reads
[code]Mods\[CP] QingQingCao Cats[/code], then start the game through SMAPI.

Safe to add to an existing save. If you remove the mod later, a save that adopted one of these cats may complain about the missing pet type - keep a backup before uninstalling.

[b]Compatibility[/b]

Content Patcher data and three PNG textures. No DLL, and nothing vanilla is edited - it adds two entries to
[code]Data/Pets[/code]. It's a pure content pack, so it should load anywhere Content Patcher does, including Android SMAPI ports for 1.6. I've only tested on PC, though.

[b]Credits[/b]

Sprites, data and page by StarLight2024. Built on Content Patcher by Pathoschild.

[list]
[*]Laowu's bib was covering too much of his chest, so it's been slimmed down - 5-7 px wide on the sitting frames now, with a smaller heart in the middle. The side and back straps got trimmed to match. Licking, sleeping and rolling frames never had the bib anyway.[/*]
[*]The cat is now called "Silver Shaded British Shorthair" in English and 围裙老吴 (Laowu in an apron) in Chinese. The old Chinese Easter egg name is retired - the 150 bees joke lives on in the plush's description.[/*]
[*]Marnie now sells a Little Bee Plush for 1,500g. Placeable decoration, sits nicely on any table or floor. Yes, it's one of the 150.[/*]
[*]Internal IDs are unchanged, so it's safe to swap in mid-save. Her shop list is appended to, not replaced, so it coexists fine with other mods unless they wipe Marnie's stock wholesale.[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]中文说明[/b][/size]

给玛尼的宠物领养商店添了两只新猫：银灰毛尖、奶白胸口、绿眼睛的银渐层，和黑背白胸、琥珀色眼睛的奶牛猫。贴图是在原版猫的画框上逐帧手绘的，走路、坐下、眨眼、舔爪、躺倒、扑跳的动作和原版一致，就是长相不同、价格贵一点。
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55070/55070-1793937857-937532650.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]银渐层：50,000 金币[/*]
[*]奶牛猫：10,000 金币[/*]
[/list]领养方式与原版相同：玛尼柜台出现「领养宠物」选项后（没有宠物且进入第二年，或看过原版领养事件）就能买。不替换原版猫，也不会出现在开局选宠界面。买之前记得准备一个空宠物碗。
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55070/55070-1793945743-163036276.png[/img]
v1.2.1 变更
老吴的围兜整体缩小：坐姿帧围兜最宽处从 10 像素收窄到 5-7 像素，不再遮住白色胸口；胸口的粉色小爱心保留。舔爪、蜷睡、打滚等帧照旧不画围兜。
名字调整：英文购买名改为「Silver Shaded British Shorthair」（银渐层英短品种名）；简体中文购买名改为「围裙老吴」。原彩蛋名「老吴【家里150只小峰】」不再用于猫名，「150只小峰」的梗移到新物品小峰玩偶的描述里。
新增物品「小峰玩偶」（Little Bee Plush）：16x16 圆滚滚蜜蜂绒玩偶，可摆放装饰（Category -99），玛尼的动物商店常年出售，售价 1,500 金币。悬停描述：中文「老吴家里150只小峰中的一员。缝得圆滚滚的，摆在院子里看一眼心情就会变好。」英文 "One of the 150 little bees that live with Laowu. Round, soft, and happy to keep watch over the yard."
小峰玩偶通过 Content Patcher 的 TargetField 列表追加写进原版 AnimalShop 商品列表，不覆盖、不重排玛尼原有商品；与其他改商店模组同时使用时，只要求对方不做整表替换。

新增第三只猫「老吴」：圆胖银白猫，戴奶油底粉条纹小围兜（胸口有粉色小爱心），绿色眼睛，脸颊比另外两只更圆。售价 50,000 金币，同样只在玛尼的宠物收养商店出现。
彩蛋：v1.2.0 时游戏语言为简体中文，购买界面名字显示「老吴【家里150只小峰】」；v1.2.1 起简体中文显示「围裙老吴」，其他语言显示 Silver Shaded British Shorthair。
满好感（10 颗心）后抚摸老吴，会送玩家金星羊奶或金星山羊奶酪，两者概率各 50%。抚摸本身一天只能进行一次，所以一天最多收到一件。金星羊奶、金星山羊奶酪都是原版物品。
贴图与购买机制沿用前两版做法：保留原版 32x32 帧位置、身体剪影、爪子动作和地面阴影，正面脸加宽 1px 显胖，商店图标扩展为三格。

需要星露谷 1.6+、SMAPI 4.0+、Content Patcher 2.0+。解压到
[code]Mods[/code]，保持
[code]Mods\[CP] QingQingCao Cats[/code]目录结构，用 SMAPI 启动游戏。纯内容包、无 DLL，不改动任何原版数据。已经领养过再卸载模组的话，存档可能报错，卸载前请先备份。
